hooks.command: python3 -c "import sys,json; d=json.load(sys.stdin); fp=d.get('tool_input',{}).get('file_path',''); exit(print('BLOCKED: data/*.json contains real production lead data — only API routes should modify these files.') or 2) if '/data/' in fp and fp.endswith('.json') else exit(0)"

python3 -c "import sys,json; d=json.load(sys.stdin); cmd=d.get('tool_input',{}).get('command',''); exit(print('Note: git push origin main deploys to thetwoapps.com immediately — confirm typecheck and build pass first.') or 1) if 'git push' in cmd and 'origin main' in cmd else exit(0)"

python3 -c "import sys,json,os; d=json.load(sys.stdin); fp=d.get('tool_input',{}).get('file_path',''); c=open(fp).read() if os.path.isfile(fp) else ''; exit(print('Missing runtime=nodejs declaration — required for data/*.json file access in API routes.') or 1) if '/app/api/' in fp and fp.endswith('.ts') and 'runtime' not in c else exit(0)"

python3 -c "import sys,json; d=json.load(sys.stdin); fp=d.get('tool_input',{}).get('file_path',''); exit(print('content/index.ts updated — verify src/app/sitemap.ts covers any new routes.') or 1) if fp.endswith('content/index.ts') else exit(0)"
git status --short 2>/dev/null | grep -q '.' && echo 'Note: uncommitted changes — run /commit when ready.' || true
